headlines.title: New cervical cancer guidance to favor HPV screening over traditional Pap tests
headlines.description: New cervical cancer guidance to recommend for the first time that women ages 30 to 65 be screened for HPV rather than with the traditional Pap test.

headlines.title: Doctors warn that now is the time to take the flu shot as cases continue to soar across the country
headlines.description: Flu cases are surging far earlier than usual, with New York City reporting a 300% jump in infections and a nearly 700% rise in hospitalizations. The CDC counts 2.6 million illnesses nationwide this season. NBC News' Sam Brock spoke to providers who say now is the time to get the shot ahead of the holidays.

headlines.title: Your Child Wants to Play ‘GTA 6’: What Parents Need to Know
headlines.description: From the global phenomenon of “Grand Theft Auto VI” to choosing the best time to go for a walk, take a look at some of the most buzzworthy stories on TODAY.com.

headlines.title: Health Hacks to Get You Through the Holiday Season
headlines.description: NBC medical contributor Dr. Kavita Patel joins TODAY to share health hacks to help you protect yourself and loved ones when traveling or gathering during the holiday season. Tips include ways to keep keep holiday stress under control, staying consistent with health goals, preventing spread if you’re feeling under the weather, and more.

headlines.title: How Music Heals Patients at St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital
headlines.description: At St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital, music is used everyday to help young patients through some of their toughest moments. Amy Love, who launched the music therapy program at the hospital, leads activities that provide comfort and care traditional medicine cannot. NBC’s Priscilla Thompson joined Amy and the hospital’s national outreach director Marlo Thomas for TODAY’s Thanks and Giving series to see firsthand how music is being used as medicine.
